name: Verisk Analytics, Inc.
summary: Verisk Analytics, Inc. engages in the provision of data analytics and technology solutions to the insurance industry in the United States and internationally. The company offers underwriting solutions, including forms, rules, and loss costs services that provides policy language, prospective loss costs, policy writing and rating rules, and underwriting solutions for risk selection and segmentation
verdict: Einstufung: Qualität (Buffett-Typ) – erfüllt 7/9 Buffett-Kriterien – stabiler, profitabler Burggraben. Buffett-Score 68/100 (Top-Firma, aber zu teuer), Innovations-Score 36/100 (Noch zu früh/zu teuer). Geschätzter fairer Wert ≈ 225.74 USD (+11 % zum Kurs). Risiko: Niedrig.
